spans.s:
m. (-र्णः)
1 The teak tree.
2 A letter.

m. (-वः)
The ocean.
E.
अर्णस् water, व affix, and स is dropped: the ण in this and similar words is optionally doubled, as अर्ण्णव, &c.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Sea-born, marine.
mn. (-जः-जं)
Cuttle fish.
E.
अर्णव, and ज born.

m. (-रः)
VARUṆA, regent of the water.
E.
अर्णव the ocean, and मन्दिर a house; whose dwelling is the deep.

m. (-तः)
A boat or ship.
E.
अर्णव, and पोत a boat.

n. (-नं)
A boat or ship.
E.
अर्णव, and यान vehicle.

n. (-र्णः)
Water.
E.
ऋ to go, असुन् Uṇādi affix, and नट् inserted.

m. (-दः)
A cloud.
E.
अर्णस्, and द what gives.

m. (-वः)
A shell.
E.
अर्णस्, and भव being.
